description: Typed-semantics benchmark: the USB resolved-pointer claims and the EIC convergence claim carry explicit structured predicates, so entity roles, relations and set scope are verified deterministically before any audit model is consulted.
objective: Determine what the USB interrupt handler's indirect callback dispatch invokes, and whether the EIC interrupt-dispatch path converges with USB interrupt handling.

claims.label: good
claims.subject: RAM function pointer 0x200052e8 consumed by the USB_OTHER handler
claims.assertion: The indirect call at 0x0000cc1a in FUN_0000cc14 loads RAM slot 0x200052e8, written by FUN_0000ccc4 at 0x0000ccc6 with the r0 argument of the call at 0x0000bcda in FUN_0000bc44; the stored raw Thumb pointer 0x0000c725 has canonical target 0x0000c724 (FUN_0000c724), which forwards to 0x0000c5cc.
claims.scope: Static census resolved function pointers for firmware autopilot868; RAM slot 0x200052e8 only.
assumptions: The registration call at 0x0000bcda executes before USB_OTHER interrupts that reach 0x0000cc1a are serviced; ordering is not established by this evidence.

claims.label: bad
claims.subject: USB callback target
claims.assertion: The USB callback target is FUN_0000ccc4 and the result is EXACT.

claims.label: eic_dispatch_convergence
claims.subject: EIC interrupt dispatch and USB interrupt path
claims.assertion: The physical/EIC interrupt-dispatch path converges with the USB interrupt path.
claims.scope: Census strong call graph, within the census hop bound.
